facts.fact: The UNDP Digital Readiness Assessment states that Madagascar has a national standards body, the Bureau des Normes de Madagascar, a correspondent member of ISO, and that public information shows no specific programme on AI or data-governance standards; the report gives no date for the body's creation, so its published date is used.

note: Certification: the report says most data centres meet only local rules or custom standards, with no ISO 27001 or SSAE 16 certification, and names no certifier; its ISO 27001 mentions are recommendations, so no certification fact. Proposals to mandate the Bureau to adopt data and AI standards and to launch a Digital Trust label are recommendations, not facts.
